description: This file defines the BadProviderConfigException class, a custom exception used in Orleans to indicate issues with storage provider configuration for grains.

classes.name: BadProviderConfigException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating bad or missing storage provider configuration for a grain.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message.
